sloka: तस्मिन्प्रहर्तुकामे तु यमे दण्डेन रावणम् ।यमं पितामहः साक्षाद्दर्शयित्वेदमब्रवीत् ।। ७.२२.३८ ॥
transliteration: tasminprahartukāme tu yame daṇḍena rāvaṇam ।yamaṁ pitāmahaḥ sākṣāddarśayitvedamabravīt ।। 7.22.38 ॥

translations.english: Then all those on the battlefield, terrified by that, fled, and all the gods were agitated upon seeing Yama with his mace raised.
